player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''SabacOwnsJ00''') posted a [[Dark]] [[Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince|Agents Of Black Sun]] list on DeckTech in August 2001.

posted: Presence of the force x2
shields_note: The post names no Defensive Shields.
notes: Byline posted as 'David_F "SabacOwnsJ00" airbanks' (the surname split around the handle); credited as David Fairbanks.

Starting cards as posted under 'starting(7)': Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince, Coruscant, Coruscant: Imperial City, Prince Xizor, Prepared Defenses, Mobilization Points (posted 'mo. points') and Imperial Arrest Order (posted 'IAO'); these count toward the 60. The strategy says the third Prepared Defenses effect is Secret Plans or Allegations Of Corruption, both listed under Effects.
Total 60 as published. Prince Xizor appears three times (one starting, two under Characters), kept as published; the strategy says the extra copies are there for when he dies.

Posted 'Coruscant' dested Coruscant (Dark) (Special Edition), as in other Vengeance Of The Dark Prince decks; the unnamed 'docking bay' dested the Special Edition Coruscant: Docking Bay, the docking bay the strategy uses for a first-turn flip next to Imperial City (the list's other three docking bays are named).

Posted 'docking bay 94' and 'death star docking bay' dested the Dark Tatooine: Docking Bay 94 (Dark) and Death Star: Docking Bay 327 (Dark); 'endor landing platform' dested Endor: Landing Platform (Docking Bay).

Posted 'mo. points' and 'IAO' dested the single Effects Mobilization Points and Imperial Arrest Order, since Secret Plans is posted separately; 'Secret Plans' is the Special Edition Effect (no Defensive Shields existed in August 2001).

Posted 'Dengar w/gun', 'iggy w/gun', '4lom w/gun' and 'fett w/gun' dested Dengar With Blaster Carbine, IG-88 With Riot Gun, 4-LOM With Concussion Rifle and Boba Fett With Blaster Rifle; 'U3PO' U-3PO (Yoo-Threepio); 'TwiLek' Twi'lek Advisor; 'Imp. Barrier' Imperial Barrier; 'Den of theives' Den Of Thieves; 'Masterful move/endor occupation' the combo Masterful Move & Endor Occupation.
